purpose: Reference gallery only. This does not replace or reduce the HouseStyles acceptance matrix.
request_factory: BrickWild.default_request("house", 8102); set each public style; preserve default trade
scale_method: For width, length, height, and storeys, use BrickWild.describe_kind("house") public min/default/max values and midpoint interpolation exactly as tools/render_personality_baseline.gd._apply_scale.
primary_views: one representative eye-level room for each present activity group: living, cooking, work, sleeping, storage
room_policy: Room groups are selected from the generated public plan. If groups share one actual room, it is rendered once and tagged with both groups. If a group has no actual room, the manifest records absent_from_generated_plan. The renderer never creates rooms or moves props.
